options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG       Path to remote_train.yaml
  --provider {mock,vastai}
                        Compute provider
  --gpu GPU             GPU name substring filter (e.g. A100)
  --min-vram MIN_VRAM   Minimum GPU VRAM in GB
  --disk DISK           Minimum/requested disk in GB (must hold model weights)
  --max-price MAX_PRICE
                        Max $/hr cap
  --max-hours MAX_HOURS
                        Max wall-clock hours (teardown watchdog)
  --verbose             Debug logging
  --notify              Telegram ping on completion.
  --resume-from RESUME_FROM
                        Local trainer checkpoint dir to continue from instead
                        of step 0.
  --trajectories-dir TRAJECTORIES_DIR
                        Corpus directory to ship (default: ./trajectories).
  --keep-on-signal      If this supervisor is killed, leave the box running so
                        the detached job finishes; recover with `python -m
                        cua.cloud.vast cleanup`.
  --push-hf PUSH_HF     HuggingFace repo to upload the adapter to.
